annotation.venue: Interoperable Europe Portal – Public Sector Tech Watch
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Public Sector Tech Watch case study of Diia.AI, Ukraine's government AI agent (chatbot) delivering public services via Diia.Engine. Describes the agentic architecture, PII anonymisation, guardrails, interoperability with the European Interoperability Framework, and citation-based transparency. Software only; no robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Diia.AI is an agentic LLM assistant that executes government services within chat.
Four-stage PII anonymisation prevents the LLM from processing personal identifiers.
Multilayer guardrails combine keyword filtering, ML classification and LLM reasoning against prompt injection.
Interoperability follows the European Interoperability Framework, using MCP and uniform JSON metadata.
Citation system links outputs to verified sources to strengthen transparency.
